9 May 2027 | winners = | best goalkeeper = }} The '''2026–27 [[Kategoria Superiore]]''' is the 88th official season, or 91st season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in [[Albania]] (including three unofficial championships during [[World War II]]) and the 27th season under the name '''Kategoria Superiore'''. The season began on 21 August 2026 and end on 9 May 2027.{{Cite web|url=https://fshf.org/sq/komiteti-ekzekutiv-i-fshf-miraton-datat-e-nisjes-se-aktiviteteve-kombetare-per-sezonin-futbollistik-2026-2027/|title=Komiteti Ekzekutiv i FSHF miraton datat e nisjes së aktiviteteve kombëtare për sezonin futbollistik 2026-2027|website=Fshf.org|date=June 25, 2026|access-date=June 25, 2026}}{{Cite web|url=https://fshf.org/sq/komiteti-ekzekutiv-i-fshf-se-miraton-ndryshimin-e-formatit-te-kampionatit-abissnet-superiore-per-sezonet-2026-2027-2027-2028-dhe-2028-2029/|title=Komiteti Ekzekutiv i FSHF-së miraton ndryshimin e formatit të kampionatit “Abissnet Superiore” për sezonet 2026/2027, 2027/2028 dhe 2028/2029|website=Fshf.org|date=June 23, 2026|access-date=July 6, 2026}} The winners of this season's Kategoria Superiore will earn a place in the [[2027–28 UEFA Champions League#First qualifying round|first qualifying round]] of the [[UEFA Champions League|2027–28 UEFA Champions League]], with the second and third placed clubs earning a place in the [[2027–28 UEFA Conference League#First qualifying round|first qualifying round]] of the [[UEFA Conference League|2027–28 UEFA Conference League]]. == Teams == Two clubs have earned promotion from the [[2025–26 Kategoria e Parë|Kategoria e Parë]], [[KF Laçi|Laçi]] (promoted after a one-year absence) and [[KF Skënderbeu Korçë|Skënderbeu]] (promoted after a one-year absence). [[KF Bylis|Bylis]] (relegated after two years in the top flight) and [[Flamurtari FC|Flamurtari]] (relegated after one year in the top flight) were relegated to [[Kategoria e Parë]] at the conclusion of [[2025–26 Kategoria Superiore|last season]]. === Locations === {{location map+ |Albania |float=right |width=300 |caption=2026–27 Kategoria Superiore teams. |places= {{location map~ |Albania |lat=41.3275 |long=19.8187 |label=[[FC Dinamo City|Dinamo]] |position=bottom}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=41.0764 |long=19.6669 |label=[[KF Egnatia|Egnatia]] |position=left}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=41.0999996|long=20.0666664|label=[[AF Elbasani|Elbasani]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=41.63556 |long=19.71306 |label=[[KF Laçi|Laçi]] |position=left}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=41.3275 |long=19.8187 |label=[[FK Partizani Tirana|Partizani]] |position=top}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=40.625833 |long=20.782778 |label=[[KF Skënderbeu Korçë|Skënderbeu]] |position=left}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=41.326081 |long=19.449856 |label=[[KF Teuta Durrës|Teuta]] |position=left}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=41.3275 |long=19.8187 |label=[[KF Tirana|Tirana]] |position=right}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=42.07 |long=19.506667 |label=[[KF Vllaznia Shkodër|Vllaznia]] |position=left}} {{location map~ |Albania |lat=41.39083|long=19.655|label=[[KF Vora|Vora]] |position=left}} }} {|class="wikitable sortable" |- !
